description: Launch contract for the agent-container image: what any launcher (docker CLI, Kubernetes, etc.) must or may supply for the image to function correctly. run.sh (this repo, local dev) and any external launcher (e.g. collie's Kubernetes Pod-builder) are reviewed against this list rather than each hand-copying it independently.

optional.name: GIT_USER_NAME
optional.purpose: git config --global user.name, set by entrypoint.sh if present

optional.name: GIT_USER_EMAIL
optional.purpose: git config --global user.email, set by entrypoint.sh if present

optional.name: TENSORZERO_BASE_URL
optional.purpose: substituted into ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json's baseURL by entrypoint.sh if present

optional.name: SKIP_FIREWALL
optional.purpose: set to 'true' to skip init-firewall.sh at container start, e.g. when the launcher already enforces egress policy itself (a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy)

optional.name: HOST_WORKSPACE
optional.purpose: informational, defaults to /workspace via the image's own ENV; override only if the launcher mounts /workspace from a host-relative path tools should report

required.purpose: the project directory agent tools operate on

optional.purpose: persists Claude Code OAuth credentials (~/.claude/.credentials.json) across restarts; without it every run needs a fresh browser login

grants Docker access inside the container (run.sh's --mount-docker-socket); not required for normal operation and widens the container's effective privileges to node/host-root-equivalent -- grant deliberately, never by default

capabilities.purpose: init-firewall.sh (run at container start unless SKIP_FIREWALL=true) configures iptables/ipset egress rules; without these capabilities it fails to apply them
